domains.name: Remote sensing and landscape science
domains.summary: Satellite imagery for monitoring vegetation, crops and land surface temperature from single fields to the whole globe: phenology-based crop mapping, NDVI–LST relationships, global time-series data, and the theory and metrics of landscape pattern and fragmentation.

domains.name: Pollination and agricultural ecology
domains.summary: How landscape structure, fragmentation and climate change affect pollinator communities and the crop pollination services they provide: plant–pollinator networks, spatial service models (including the PollMap software), crop–pollinator overlap, urban agriculture and trends in pollinator data.

domains.name: Species distribution modelling and climate change
domains.summary: Species distribution models that project how habitat suitability shifts under future climates, applied to bees, butterflies, pollinator-dependent crops, invasive hornets and Persian fallow deer, together with work on predictor choice and on adding species interactions to these models.

domains.name: Biodiversity and conservation
domains.summary: Human and climatic pressures on Iran's protected areas, wetlands and reservoirs, protected-area zoning and land-use planning, and the corridors that keep wildlife populations connected.

themes.name: Vegetation, climate and land surface temperature
Range shifts of pollinators and crops
Predictors and species interactions in SDMs
Protected areas, environmental pressures and planning
